verdict: ROAS solid at 5.01, but GBP visibility needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.01 for every $1.00 spent, generating 39 purchases and $7,422.61 in revenue on $1,482.15 in spend — a healthy return overall. That said, the most recent week showed a 21.64% dip in return on ad spend and only 3 purchases in the last three days versus 8 in the three days prior, signalling a short-term softening we're watching closely. More pressing is your Google Business Profile: actions dropped to zero on September 12–13 after averaging roughly 25 per day for the prior 45 days, a 57.82% weekly decline that points to a profile visibility issue, not ad fatigue. We're actively investigating and restoring that profile presence now. Four planned milestones from August are also being closed out this period, with key deliverables — including funnel tracking and subscribe pages — on schedule for September 30.
